12092-the-oxford-movement-twelve-years-1.title: The Oxford Movement Twelve Years 1833 1845
12092-the-oxford-movement-twelve-years-1.creator: Unknown
12092-the-oxford-movement-twelve-years-1.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The following pages relate to that stage in the Church revival of this century which is familiarly known as the Oxford Movement, or, to use its nickname, the Tractarian Movement. Various side influences and conditions affected it at its beginning and in its course; but the impelling and governing force was, throughout the years with which these pages are concerned, at Oxford. It was naturally and justly associated with Oxford, from which it received some of its most marked characteristics.

arxiv-2010-01094.title: CMC Doublings of Minimal Surfaces via Min-Max
arxiv-2010-01094.creator: Liam Mazurowski
arxiv-2010-01094.description: Abstract . Let Σ 2 ⊂ M 3 \Sigma^{2}\subset M^{3} be a minimal surface of index 0 or 1. Assume that a neighborhood of Σ \Sigma can be foliated by constant mean curvature (cmc) hypersurfaces. We use min-max theory and the catenoid estimate to construct ε \varepsilon -cmc doublings of Σ \Sigma for small ε > 0 \varepsilon>0 .

arxiv-2101-09040.title: Blast waves in a paraxial fluid of light
arxiv-2101-09040.creator: Murad Abuzarli, Tom Bienaimé, Elisabeth Giacobino, Alberto Bramati, Quentin Glorieux
arxiv-2101-09040.description: Abstract We study experimentally blast wave dynamics on a weakly interacting fluid of light. The fluid density and velocity are measured in 1D and 2D geometries. Using a state equation arising from the analogy between optical propagation in the paraxial approximation and the hydrodynamic Euler’s equation, we access the fluid hydrostatic and dynamic pressure.

arxiv-2106-13079.title: First 3D vector tracking of helium recoils for fast neutron measurements at SuperKEKB
arxiv-2106-13079.creator: M. T. Hedges, S. E. Vahsen, I. Jaegle, P. M. Lewis, H. Nakayama, J. Schueler, T. N. Thorpe
arxiv-2106-13079.description: Abstract We present results from the first deployment of novel, high definition, compact gas Time Projection Chambers (TPCs) with pixel chip readout as part of the BEAST II beam background measurement project at SuperKEKB. The TPCs provide detailed 3D imaging of ionization from neutron-induced nuclear recoils in a helium and carbon dioxide target gas mixture at standard temperature and pressure.

arxiv-2106-14197.title: BS-RIS-User Association and Beamforming Designs for RIS-aided Cellular Networks
arxiv-2106-14197.creator: Sifan Liu † , Pengfei Ni † , Rang Liu † , Yang Liu † , Ming Li †∗ , and Qian Liu ‡
arxiv-2106-14197.description: Abstract Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) has been regarded as a revolutionary and promising technology owing to its powerful feature of adaptively shaping wireless propagation environment. However, as a frequency-selective device, the RIS can only effectively provide tunable phase-shifts for signals within a certain frequency band.

arxiv-2208-12561.title: Computing Maximum Fixed Point Solutions over Feasible Paths in Data Flow Analyses
arxiv-2208-12561.creator: Komal Pathade, Uday Khedker
arxiv-2208-12561.description: Abstract The control flow graph (CFG) representation of a procedure used by virtually all flow-sensitive program analyses, admits a large number of infeasible control flow paths i.e., these paths do not occur in any execution of the program. Hence the information reaching along infeasible paths in an analysis is spurious.

arxiv-2306-14241.title: Impact of Network Delay and Decision Imperfections in IoT Assisted Cruise Ship Evacuation Thanks: This research was partially funded by the EU H2020 Program’s IoTAC Research and Innovation Action under Grant No. 952684 at the Institute of Theoretical and Applied Informatics, Polish Academy of Scienc
arxiv-2306-14241.creator: Yuting Ma, Erol Gelenbe, Kezhong Liu
arxiv-2306-14241.description: Abstract Major challenges of assisting passengers to safely and quickly escape from ships when an emergency occurs, include complex realistic features such as human behavior uncertainty, dynamic human traversal times, and the computation and communication delays in the systems that offer advice to users during an emergency.

arxiv-2310-02337.title: Hilbert expansion of Boltzmann equation with soft potentials and specular boundary condition in half-space
arxiv-2310-02337.creator: Jing Ouyang, Yong Wang
arxiv-2310-02337.description: Abstract . Boundary effects play an important role in the study of hydrodynamic limits in the Boltzmann theory. We justify rigorously the validity of the hydrodynamic limit from the Boltzmann equation of soft potentials to the compressible Euler equations by the Hilbert expansion with multi-scales.

arxiv-2310-15360.title: Algorithm for Invalidation of Cached Results of Queries to a Single Table
arxiv-2310-15360.creator: Jakub Łopuszański
arxiv-2310-15360.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jakub Łopuszański. One of the most popular setups for a back-end of a high performance website consists of a relational database and a cache which stores results of performed queries. Several application frameworks support caching of queries made to the database, but few of them handle cache invalidation correctly, resorting to simpler solutions such as short TTL values, or flushing the whole cache after any write to the database.

arxiv-2501-10190.title: Temporal Causal Reasoning with (Non-Recursive) Structural Equation Models
arxiv-2501-10190.creator: Maksim Gladyshev, Natasha Alechina, Mehdi Dastani, Dragan Doder, Brian Logan
arxiv-2501-10190.description: Abstract Structural Equation Models (SEM) are the standard approach to representing causal dependencies between variables in causal models. In this paper we propose a new interpretation of SEMs when reasoning about Actual Causality, in which SEMs are viewed as mechanisms transforming the dynamics of exogenous variables into the dynamics of endogenous variables.

arxiv-2503-06609.title: Quantum Speedup in Dissecting Roots and Solving Nonlinear Algebraic Equations
arxiv-2503-06609.creator: Nhat A. Nghiem
arxiv-2503-06609.description: Abstract It is shown that quantum computer can detect the existence of root of a function almost exponentially more efficient than the classical counterpart. It is also shown that a quantum computer can produce quantum state corresponding to the solution of nonlinear algebraic equations quadratically faster than the best known classical approach.

arxiv-2504-15765.title: Quantum Aberrations: Entangling Photons with Zernike Polynomials
arxiv-2504-15765.creator: H. Avetisyan, G. Nikoghosyan
arxiv-2504-15765.description: Abstract We introduce Zernike polynomials as a novel degree of freedom for encoding quantum information in the spatial structure of photons. Building on their orthogonality and completeness over the unit disc, we develop a framework for generating, manipulating, and detecting photons in Zernike modes, and propose methods for realizing single-photon and two-photon Zernike wave packets.

pmc-10731345.title: Development and validation of a nomogram for predicting the overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer patients with liver metastasis
pmc-10731345.creator: Tian Xu, Xianling Liu, Chaoyuan Liu, Zui Chen, Fang Ma, Dan Fan
pmc-10731345.description: BackgroundAmong all metastatic lesions in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), liver metastasis (LM) is the most lethal site with a median survival of less than 5 months. Few studies exclusively report on prognostic factors for these unique patients. We aimed to construct and validate a practical model to predict the prognosis of NSCLC patients with LM.

pmc-10963061.title: EPIC-TRACE: predicting TCR binding to unseen epitopes using attention and contextualized embeddings
pmc-10963061.creator: Dani Korpela, Emmi Jokinen, Alexandru Dumitrescu, Jani Huuhtanen, Satu Mustjoki, Harri Lähdesmäki
pmc-10963061.description: MotivationT cells play an essential role in adaptive immune system to fight pathogens and cancer but may also give rise to autoimmune diseases. The recognition of a peptide–MHC (pMHC) complex by a T cell receptor (TCR) is required to elicit an immune response.

pmc-11507585.title: Unveiling the Metabolomic Profile of Oily Sensitive Skin: A Non-Invasive Approach
pmc-11507585.creator: Jiaqi Zhang, Fan Wu, Jun Wang, Yi Qin, Yao Pan, Roberta Ottria
pmc-11507585.description: Skin barrier impairment is becoming increasingly common due to changes in lifestyle and modern living environments. Oily sensitive skin (OSS) is a condition that is characterized by an impaired skin barrier. Thus, examining the differences between OSS and healthy skin will enable a more objective evaluation of the characteristics of OSS and facilitate investigations of potential treatments.

pmc-11970158.title: Knowledge, attitude and use of herbal medicine among pregnant women attending antenatal care in nsukka, Nigeria
pmc-11970158.creator: Obinna Felix Dim, Chigozie Gloria Anene-Okeke, Chinwe Victoria Ukwe
pmc-11970158.description: ObjectiveTo assess the knowledge, attitude and use of herbal medicine among pregnant women attending antenatal in Nsukka, Enugu state Nigeria.MethodsThis was a cross- sectional descriptive study carried out among pregnant women attending ante- natal in selected hospitals in Nsukka, Enugu State from June-August 2022. A 33 item well-structured questionnaire was used as a data collection tool.

pmc-12772926.title: Drug Delivery Through Placenta and Then Breastmilk for Fetal Cystic Fibrosis: Collateral Benefit and Social Good Do Not Make an Acceptable Risk: Benefit Ratio
pmc-12772926.creator: Teri L. Hernandez, Michael V. Zaretsky, Brian M. Jackson, Gianna G. Morales, Curtis R. Coughlin, David Badesch, Matthew DeCamp
pmc-12772926.description: ks and benefits is necessary. Here we focus on two questions: (1) Do collateral benefits “count” in the risk-benefit assessment for the pregnant person and after delivery?; and (2) To what extent, if any, should the social context influence ethical decision making?

pmc-12808085.title: Structure and community assembly of rare bacterial community in sediments of Sancha Lake
pmc-12808085.creator: Yong Li, Yajie Li, Yihan Wu, Zuguang Liu, Shiqi Luo, Sidan Gong
pmc-12808085.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To explore the structure and assembly of the rare bacterial community within sediment samples, as well as their responses their responses to environmental influencing factors, we collected surface sediment and overlying water samples from Sancha Lake across four seasons. MiSeq high-throughput sequencing was applied to the V3-V4 hypervariable regions of the 16 S rRNA genes, and the β - Nearest Taxon index (βNTI) was utilized to analyze the bacterial community assembly in the sediment samples.

pmc-13062783.title: Reproductive isolation in two strains of the marine rotifer Brachionus cf. ibericus (Rotifera, Monogononta) from Quintana Roo, México
pmc-13062783.creator: Ailem Guadalupe Marin-Chan, Daniela Pérez-Yáñez, Gilberto Acosta-González, Jesús Alvarado-Flores
pmc-13062783.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In the Yucatán Peninsula, no reproductive analyses have been conducted on clones of the Brachionus plicatilis species complex, a group of significant economic, ecological and evolutionary importance. Recent studies have identified 15 distinct genetic lineages. Therefore, in this study, our aim was to cultivate and characterise clones within this group to study reproductive isolation in the Yucatán Peninsula, specifically in the State of Quintana Roo.

pmc-13262536.title: Prevalence and Correlates of Steatotic Liver Disease Among People With HIV in Uganda
pmc-13262536.creator: Prossy Bibangambah, Moses Acan, Brian Ghoshhajra, Geoffrey Erem, Rita Nassanga, Andrew Ochieng, Vikas Thondapu, Michael T Lu, Mangun Randhawa, Angelo Takigami, Zahra Reynolds, Flavia Atwiine, Edna Tindimwebwa, Rebecca F Gilbert, Susanne S Hoepner, Eliza Passell, Shruti Sagar, Yao Tong, Ntobeko A B N
pmc-13262536.description: BackgroundLiver disease is an important cause of morbidity and mortality among people with HIV (PWH). Steatotic liver disease (SLD) is a leading cause of liver disease among PWH in the Global North. However, there is a dearth of data on the epidemiology of SLD in sub-Saharan Africa.

pmc-13280802.title: Responsive Mealtime Matters: Feeding Autonomy and Varied Settings Were Associated With Problem‐Solving Skills of Ethiopian Children Aged 6–23 Months
pmc-13280802.creator: Hailu Hailemariam, Barbara J Stoecker, Zelalem Tafese Wondimagegne
pmc-13280802.description: Although Ethiopia has established an early childhood development (ECD) policy framework and implemented various nutrition and health interventions, substantial risks for poor ECD outcomes persist. This study aimed to determine the association between responsive feeding (RF) practices and problem‐solving skills of children aged 6–23 months.

pmc-13434043.title: Efficient and metal catalyst-free approach towards highly-substituted N-sulfonylpiperidine-/mono-spiro-1,2,4,5-tetraoxanes for potential applications in chemotherapy
pmc-13434043.creator: Mohit K. Tiwari, Malgorzata Kucinska, Agnieszka Zgoła-Grześkowiak, Philippe Grellier, Marek Murias, Łukasz Marczak, Lukasz Popenda, Tomasz Goslinski
pmc-13434043.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A highly efficient metal and catalyst-free approach for the preparation of synthetically challenged tri-OMe-aryl-substituted heterocyclic, di-/tri-OMe-aryl-based cyclic and acyclic 1,2,4,5-tetraoxanes (5a–l and 6a–k) is presented herein. Under green-chemistry conditions, the reactions occur in two key steps.

pmc-13492003.title: Comparing Neurodevelopmental Outcome among Neonates with Jaundice Due to ABO and Rh Incompatibility
pmc-13492003.creator: Hassan Boskabadi, Elnaz Farajirad, Fathemeh Bagheri, Farima Farsi, Shima Imannezhad
pmc-13492003.description: Objectives: Evaluating risk factors is essential in the context of hyperbilirubinemia and its clinical outcomes, particularly when attributed to its primary causes: maternal-fetal ABO and Rh incompatibility. This study aims to determine the prevalence rate of predisposing factors and complications of hyperbilirubinemia in newborns with ABO blood group incompatibility, compared to those with Rh incompatibility.

pmc-13503851.title: Natural dyeing of wool fabric with Sappan via the atmospheric-pressure non-equilibrium microwave plasma system
pmc-13503851.creator: Wittawat Poonthong, Toshifumi Yuji, Shinichi Tashiro, Daisuke Hirotani, Narong Mungkung, Nat Kasayapanand
pmc-13503851.description: This study presents an improved natural dyeing method for wool fabric utilizing Sappan wood, achieved by integrating iron mordant treatment with atmospheric-pressure non-equilibrium microwave plasma irradiation. The dyeing process was conducted at 80 °C with a 2.0 wt% Sappan dye solution, and plasma irradiation was applied both during and after the dyeing procedure.

pmc-13520526.title: Obesity and age increase hypoxia risk during esophagogastroduodenoscopy under monitored anesthesia care: risk stratification and evaluation of a procedural oxygen mask
pmc-13520526.creator: Sam Bonge, Maaz Majid, James M Mirocha, Theodore Stein, Deena Midani, Derek Cheng, David Padua, Joshua Levy, Megumi Nakamura
pmc-13520526.description: BackgroundDeep sedation under monitored anesthesia care (MAC) during esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) has a significant risk of hypoxia in obese patients. Recently high flow nasal cannula studies were conducted with good results for obese patients, however, data on Procedural Oxygen Mask (POM) are extremely scarce.
